description: Hand-written business conversations with expected labels, used to evaluate the TalkWiseAI agents. Transcripts are synthetic; the labels were written and checked by the project team against each transcript. Where more than one label is defensible, every acceptable value is listed.

examples.title: Discovery call: 200-seat PBX migration
segments: Hi Dana, thanks for making time today. I understand Northwind is reviewing its phone system?
Yes. We have about 200 staff on an old on-premise PBX and calls drop several times a day.
That sounds painful. What would a good outcome look like for you?
Reliable calls, UK and US numbers, and call recording for compliance. We want to switch before our contract ends in March.
We cover all three. Our Business plan includes recording and local numbers in both countries.
What does it cost? RingCentral quoted us 25 dollars per seat and honestly your list price looks higher.
For 200 seats on an annual plan we can bring it to 24 dollars per seat, including onboarding.
That helps. I'm the decision maker together with our CFO, and we have budget approved for this quarter.
Great. I'll send a written proposal by Friday and set up a demo for your IT team next week.
Perfect, please include the compliance details for call recording.

examples.title: Support: repeated dropped calls
segments: Thank you for calling support, this is Sam. How can I help?
This is the third time this week our sales team has had calls cut off mid-conversation. It's costing us deals.
I'm sorry about that. Can you tell me which office is affected?
The Leeds office. Every call drops after about ten minutes. I'm really frustrated, we pay for premium support.
I can see packet loss on your Leeds trunk. I'm escalating this to our network team as a priority ticket right now.
If this isn't fixed soon we'll look at moving to Vonage.
Understood. I'll call you back tomorrow morning with an update from the network engineers.

examples.title: Product demo: CRM integration and security questions
segments: Let me share my screen and walk you through the call analytics dashboard.
Looks clean. Does it integrate with Salesforce? Our reps live in Salesforce all day.
We have a native Salesforce integration that logs every call automatically.
Our security team will ask where recordings are stored and whether you're SOC 2 certified.
Recordings stay in UK data centres and we completed SOC 2 Type II last year. I can send the report.
We are also trialling Aircall at the moment, so we'll compare the two.
That's fair. Would a two-week free trial help with the comparison?
Yes, set up the trial and send the SOC 2 report so security can review it.

examples.title: Internal meeting: Q3 support planning
segments: Let's start. The goal today is to agree the Q3 plan for the support team.
Ticket volume grew 18 percent last quarter, mostly password resets.
I suggest we add a self-service password reset page. I can have a draft spec ready by the 15th.
Agreed, Priya owns the spec. We also decided to hire one more support agent for the evening shift.
I'll post the job advert this week.
Open question: do we extend weekend coverage? Let's revisit that at next Tuesday's meeting.

examples.title: Follow-up: contract negotiation
segments: Thanks for reviewing the proposal. Where did you land?
We like the product, but Zoom Phone came in about fifteen percent cheaper.
I understand. Our price includes 24/7 support and call recording, which Zoom charges extra for.
That's a fair point. The other issue is timing; our budget for new tools opens next quarter, not now.
We could start the contract in July so billing lines up with your new budget.
That could work. Send me a revised quote with a July start date and I'll take it to finance.

examples.title: Cancellation request with retention offer
segments: Hello, account management, this is Leo.
Hi. I want to cancel our account at the end of the month. We've signed with 8x8.
I'm sorry to hear that. May I ask what led to the decision?
Mostly cost. We're a small team of eight and the bill went up again this year.
I can offer three months at half price and move you to the Starter plan, which fits a team your size.
I appreciate it, but the contract with 8x8 is already signed. Please just process the cancellation.
Understood. I'll process the cancellation for the 31st and email you a confirmation today.
